message: The aspect or template provider type '{0}' defined in the assembly '{1}' cannot be found in the current compilation.
title: An aspect type defined in a referenced assembly cannot be found in the compilation.
rationale: The title says 'reference assembly', which designates a metadata-only assembly, instead of 'referenced assembly'. The report site (TemplateClassFactory.GetClasses) is shared by AspectClassFactory and OtherTemplateClassFactory, so the type can also be a template provider, and '{1}' is the assembly name (RunTimeIdentity.Name), not an 'aspect library'. The word order of the message is also awkward.
